About Slop Orders

Slop Orders keeps your customers, products and orders. An order can be a draft, confirmed, fulfilled or cancelled, and fulfilling it takes the stock out. One click turns an order into an invoice draft, and the order keeps a link to it. Totals include tax and discounts, and the order can be saved as a PDF. Everything stays in this browser, and nothing is uploaded.
